_why: A milestone, not an item list. Six requirements, each with its own gate, so a machine can exhaust them one at a time and a reader can see WHICH requirement is unmet. Written 2026-09-17 after reproducing the editor's state: it renders and saves, but offers no preview anywhere (iframes: [], no [data-theme-preview]) and its colour fields do not show their values - so the operator cannot see what a change does without saving and leaving the page.
deliverable: The Akira Theme Studio editor is usable: an operator can SEE the theme, CHANGE it, SEE the change before saving, keep it, or discard it.

requirements.statement: The editor shows a preview of the theme being edited.
Every colour field shows its current value where the operator can read it.
requirements.evidence: the 22 colour fields, each with a readable value
requirements.measured_before: 22 colour inputs carry correct values in the DOM (#005c55, ...) but render as boxes that show nothing

requirements.statement: Changing a colour updates the preview before anything is saved.
requirements.evidence: preview token follows the edited value with no save
requirements.measured_before: not possible - there is nothing to update

requirements.statement: Saving keeps the values, and re-saving an unchanged form is safe.
requirements.measured_before: form exists (csrf token + idempotency key present); round-trip unverified

requirements.evidence: a discard/reset/revert control that restores loaded values
requirements.measured_before: absent - the only controls are 'Save customization' and Activate

requirements.statement: The editor loads and saves with no console errors and no failed requests.
requirements.measured_before: already true - this is a regression guard, not new work
